sections.title: The general information game and minimax comparisons

missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: ED26-P15-CH-huber-information-game-C009 partial: the converse direction of source Theorem 2(ii) (Huber 1964 p.87, proof p.88) is not stated or proved. That direction says a saddlepoint (psi0,F0), with a nonzero multiple of -f0'/f0 admissible, forces I(F0)<=I(F) on C. thm:p15-information-saddlepoint-criterion (handbook/parts/p15/huber-information-game.tex lines 184-207) assumes F_* is already a minimizer.

assessment_dispute: ED26-P15-CH-huber-information-game-C010 partial: the source Remark after Theorem 5 (p.91) says (psi0,F0) is also a saddlepoint of V(psi,F). The handbook states and proves only the upper half, E_F psi^2/d_F^2<=1/alpha (huber-information-game.tex lines 225-235). The lower half, V(psi,F0)>=V(psi0,F0), is not given for the general class; it appears only for the log-concave prototype in C013.
assessment_dispute: US-0 not discharged because C009 and C010 are partial. The other 13 components (C001-C008, C011-C015) are covered.

reader_evidence.read_extent: locator inspected; full planned section/source/proof extent not assessed in this block
